title: Asymptotic behavior for the damped Schrödinger equation with nonlinear dissipation
summary: We consider large time asymptotics of solutions to the damped Schrödinger equation with the nonlinear dissipation in the mass-subcritical case. We prove that the optimal $L^2$-decay rate of the nonlinear solution coincides with that of the corresponding linear solution even in the presence of nonlinear dissipation. Moreover, we give the optimal convergence rate for scattering for any power in the mass-subcritical regime.
